a.lede: The PHP security team is warning administrators to prepare for emergency security updates tomorrow to address two critical vulnerabilities, as information about the flaws has reportedly leaked ahead of their scheduled disclosure. [...]
a.title: PHP warns admins of two critical flaws, emergency patches coming tomorrow

b.lede: F5 has released out-of-band security patches to address multiple NGINX web server flaws, including three critical-severity vulnerabilities that can let attackers execute code on vulnerable systems. [...]
b.title: F5 releases out-of-band patches for critical NGINX vulnerabilities
